title: A coproduct of sheaves of sets is the directed colimit of its finite subcoproducts, with injective transition maps
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space (sheaves of sets on $X$ are those on the site of open subsets of $X$ with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]), $A$ a set and $(\mathcal G_a)_{a\in A}$ a family of sheaves of sets on $X$. For every subset $A'\subseteq A$ let $(C_{A'},(\iota^{A'}_a)_{a\in A'})$ be a coproduct of $(\mathcal G_a)_{a\in A'}$ in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] (coproducts of sheaves of sets exist), and for $A'\subseteq A''\subseteq A$ let $\kappa_{A''A'}:C_{A'}\to C_{A''}$ be the unique morphism with $\kappa_{A''A'}\circ\iota^{A'}_a=\iota^{A''}_a$ for all $a\in A'$; write $C=C_A$ and $\kappa_{A'}=\kappa_{AA'}$. Then: (1) the finite subsets of $A$, ordered by inclusion, form a directed set (nonempty, any two have a common upper bound), $(C_{A'},\kappa_{A''A'})$ is a system of sheaves over it ($\kappa_{A'A'}=\mathrm{id}$, $\kappa_{A'''A''}\kappa_{A''A'}=\kappa_{A'''A'}$), and $(C,(\kappa_{A'})_{A'\text{ finite}})$ is a colimit of this system in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$; (2) for all subsets $A'\subseteq A''\subseteq A$ and every open $W\subseteq X$ the map of sets $\kappa_{A''A',W}:C_{A'}(W)\to C_{A''}(W)$ is injective.
